A language-model item writer for the item-revision loop

Source: R/loop-steps.R
loop_writer_llm.Rd

loop_writer_llm() makes the writer step of revision_loop(): One call asks a language model to write n_per_scale Likert items for every scale of the loop_construct(), with about reverse_share of them reverse-keyed, and to explain its choices in a short note (logged as writer_reasoning in the runs table). Items are named after their scale (sincerity01, sincerity02, ...).

Usage

loop_writer_llm(model, guidelines = lp_guidelines)

Arguments

model

an sc_model() for the item writer. Use a different model family from the respondents to avoid items that are only easy for one family to agree with.

guidelines

item-writing guidelines added to the system prompt.

Value

A function for the writer argument of revision_loop().

Details

With sc_model("mock"), no model is called: The items are placeholders, which is enough to try the loop.

See also

revision_loop(), loop_reviser_llm()

Examples

w <- loop_writer_llm(sc_model("mock"))
w(loop_construct("Grit", "Perseverance and passion for long-term goals.",
                 n_per_scale = 3), list())$items
#>     item scale reverse
#> 1 Grit01  Grit   FALSE
#> 2 Grit02  Grit   FALSE
#> 3 Grit03  Grit    TRUE
#>                                                                     statement
#> 1            Mock item 1 about Perseverance and passion for long-term goals..
#> 2            Mock item 2 about Perseverance and passion for long-term goals..
#> 3 Mock item 3 about Perseverance and passion for long-term goals. (reversed).
